meta.title: AgentBridge — GitHub MCP Connector & Portable Authentication Architecture
meta.subtitle: Streamable HTTP Remote MCP Transport, OS Keyring Credentials & Policy Boundaries
meta.description: System architecture of Phase 7.8A GitHub Remote MCP Connector in AgentBridge. Illustrates user-facing CLI and runtime callers, ConnectorRegistry orchestration, GitHubMCPConnector adapter, portable OS Keyring and environment variable credential providers, MCPClient / MCPSession core, HttpMCPTransport streamable HTTP dispatch to the official GitHub Remote MCP endpoint (https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/), PolicyEngine risk boundary, and SQLite ActivityStore audit correlation.

components.label:
AgentBridge CLI / Runtime / Telegram
(sutra/connectors/cli.py)
components.description: User-facing CLI commands (add, auth, test, status, tools, remove) and autonomous runtime agent invocation.

components.label:
ConnectorRegistry
(sutra/connectors/registry.py)
components.description: Central lifecycle coordinator managing connector registration, persistent non-secret SQLite config, state transitions, and health probes.

components.label:
GitHubCredentialProvider
(sutra/credentials.py)
components.description: Portable credential abstraction resolving credentials via Memory > SUTRA_GITHUB_TOKEN > GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN > OS Keyring with zero token echoing or persistence leaks.

components.label:
OS Keyring Backend
(Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service)
components.description: Secure operating system credential storage protecting PAT secrets outside git repositories and SQLite databases.

components.label:
GitHubMCPConnector
(sutra/connectors/mcp/github.py)
components.description: Domain connector adapter wrapping MCPConnector, configuring default HTTPS endpoint (https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/), dynamic auth headers injection, and sanitizing descriptors.

components.label:
MCPClient
(sutra/connectors/mcp/client.py)
components.description: Domain-level MCP client orchestrating tools discovery (tools/list), invocations (tools/call), and bounded pagination.

components.label:
MCPSession
(sutra/connectors/mcp/session.py)
components.description: Protocol coordinator maintaining session FSM and protocol version negotiation (2026-07-28, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05).

components.label:
HttpMCPTransport
(sutra/connectors/mcp/http.py)
components.description: Remote transport implementing Streamable HTTP over HTTPS with authorization header injection, request timeouts, and error mapping.

components.label:
GitHub Remote MCP Server
(https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/)
components.description: Official GitHub Remote MCP server exposing GitHub tools (repos, issues, PRs, code search) authenticated via Bearer token.

components.label:
PolicyEngine
(sutra/policy_engine.py)
components.description: Centralized permission policy engine enforcing deterministic precedence: CRITICAL safety invariants > session grants > persistent workspace/global policies > risk defaults.

components.label:
ActivityStore
(sutra/activity_store.py)
components.description: Local SQLite audit trail recording connector lifecycle events and tool call starts/completions correlated by request_id without secret tokens.

relationships.label: Evaluates tool permissions prior to dispatch
